grammar.summary: 本课学习 have 表用餐与 nearly/almost 的用法。

points.title: have 表吃喝动作
points.explanation: have a meal / have lunch / have a cigarette —— 此处 have 是动作动词，疑问用 Do you have...? 或 Have you had...?

points.title: nearly 表"几乎"
points.explanation: nearly 与 almost 通用，修饰动词或整句：The dinner is nearly ready. 放在 be 与形容词之间。
